sloka: नक्षत्रेषु प्रशस्तेषु मुहूर्तेषु च तद्विदः ।निवेशम् स्थापयाम् आसुर् भरतस्य महात्मनः ॥२-८०-१७॥
transliteration: nakṣatreṣu praśasteṣu muhūrteṣu ca tadvidaḥ ।niveśam sthāpayām āsur bharatasya mahātmanaḥ ॥2-80-17॥

translations.english: Men wellversed in the study of planetary positions relating to auspicious constellations and auspicious times arranged different restingplaces at different times during the sojourn of great Bharata.
